issue: Landlord refuses to return security deposit
right: Tenant is entitled to full deposit return minus documented damages, within a reasonable period after vacating (varies by state Rent Control Act).
authority: Rent Controller / Small Causes Court (state-specific) or send a legal notice first.
documents_needed: Rent agreement, deposit receipt, vacate notice copy

issue: Landlord cuts off electricity or water supply
right: It is illegal for a landlord to disconnect essential services (Section 31/32 of various Rent Control Acts) to force eviction or for unpaid rent.
authority: Rent Controller or Local Police Station (for immediate relief).
documents_needed: Rent agreement, proof of residence, utility bills

issue: Landlord demands sudden, unreasonable rent increase
right: Rent increases must follow the terms of the signed agreement or local Rent Control Act limits (often capped at around 10% annually or bi-annually).
documents_needed: Current rent agreement, previous rent receipts

right: Landlords cannot forcibly evict tenants without a court order and legally mandated notice period (usually 30 days minimum).
authority: Civil Court / Police (if physical force is used).
documents_needed: Rent agreement, police complaint if threatened

issue: Landlord enters premises without permission or notice
right: Tenants have a right to privacy. Landlords must give reasonable prior notice (typically 24 hours) before entering for inspections or repairs.
authority: Local Police (if trespassing) or send a legal notice.
documents_needed: Rent agreement, evidence of unauthorized entry

issue: Employer refuses to pay salary or is delaying salary
right: Employees have a right to receive wages on time under the Payment of Wages Act, 1936.
documents_needed: Offer letter, bank statements, emails demanding pay

issue: Wrongful termination without notice or severance
right: Termination must comply with the employment contract and Industrial Disputes Act (if applicable), requiring proper notice or pay in lieu.
Women have the right to a safe workplace. The POSH Act 2013 mandates an Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) for companies with 10+ employees.
authority: Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) or Local Complaints Committee (LCC) / Police.
documents_needed: Written complaint, any evidence (emails, texts, witnesses)

right: Under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961, eligible female employees are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave.
documents_needed: Medical certificates, leave application, employment proof

right: Under the Factories Act and State Shops & Establishments Acts, overtime work must be compensated, typically at twice the normal wage rate.

issue: Defective product purchased, seller refuses refund/replacement
right: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, consumers can seek refund or replacement for defective goods.
authority: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (Consumer Forum).
documents_needed: Original invoice, warranty card, communication with seller

right: It is illegal to sell a packaged product at a price higher than the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) under the Legal Metrology Act.
documents_needed: Original bill showing price paid, photo of product MRP

right: Consumers are protected against false or misleading advertisements under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
authority: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) / Consumer Forum.
documents_needed: Copy/screenshot of advertisement, proof of purchase

issue: Service provider deficiency (e.g., broadband, airlines, insurance)
right: Consumers can claim compensation for deficiency in services (delays, poor quality, failure to deliver) under the CPA, 2019.
authority: District Consumer Forum / Sector-specific ombudsman (e.g., Insurance Ombudsman).
documents_needed: Service contract, bills, proof of deficiency, complaint emails

issue: E-commerce delivery failure or fake product
right: E-commerce platforms are liable for unfair trade practices and must assist in grievance redressal under E-commerce Rules 2020.
documents_needed: Order confirmation, payment receipt, photos of fake product/empty box
